title: [Riso] Account Switch – Contract and Lesson History – Riso and Nichibei students – Visibility follows organization
description: AC PX-3249.01 — Decision Table — Contract Info and Lesson History are displayed for Riso and hidden for Nichibei after a parent switches students.
preconditions:
- Parent CrossOrg is logged in to the mobile app.
- Parent CrossOrg is linked to Student Riso at Riso.
- Parent CrossOrg is linked to Student Nichibei at Nichibei.
- Student Riso has Contract Info and Lesson History records.
- Student Nichibei has lesson records.
steps_actions:
1. "Parent CrossOrg selects Student Riso and opens the account menu."
2. "Parent CrossOrg opens Contract Info and Lesson History for Student Riso."
3. "Parent CrossOrg switches to Student Nichibei and opens the account menu."
4. "Parent CrossOrg switches back to Student Riso and opens the account menu."
steps_result:
1. "The account menu provides Contract Info and Lesson History for Student Riso."
2. "Contract Info and Lesson History display Student Riso's records."
3. "Contract Info and Lesson History are not available for Student Nichibei."
4. "Contract Info and Lesson History are available again for Student Riso."
steps_data:
1. "selected student = Student Riso; organization = Riso"
2. "selected student = Student Riso"
3. "selected student = Student Nichibei; organization = Nichibei"
4. "selected student = Student Riso; organization = Riso"
